added.title: Senior Vice President, Digital Product Manager
added.description:
As a SVP,
Digital Product Manager
within Citi Wealth, you will be responsible for defining the digital product strategy for our clients, managing a portfolio of digital products, and working closely with a team of peer product managers to deliver innovative and impactful solutions. You will translate high-level business objectives and complex client needs into strategic wealth management product initiatives, fostering a culture of innovation and data-driven decision-making within the product group. Leading the strategy for our US Consumer Wealth self-directed and managed account digital features across client channels, you will partner horizontally with peer product groups and business stakeholders to deliver best-in-class enhancements. You will move with speed to deliver for our clients in support of our Digital Wealth roadmap; consistent with the pace of financial services and technology industries. The ideal candidate for this role has delivered organizational-wide innovations at scale, has a keen sense of user experience and technical acumen, and has a proven track record of measured improvements to commercial and client KPIs/OKRs.

Responsibilities:

Leads the end-to-end digital client experience as a lead digital product manager supporting our US Consumer Wealth products and enhancements.
Leads the partnership with technology stakeholders (engineering, UX/UI, QA) to strategize, prioritize, and deliver innovative client-first solutions.
Uses or commissions research, studies and focus groups to identify best-in-class benchmarks for solving business problems.
Defines and measures the OKRs & KPIs for our digital platform products.
Is able to make trade-off decisions on multiple platform products in a portfolio.
Analyzes digital product performance using tools such as Adobe, Glassbox, Qualtrics, Splunk, and Tableau reporting.
Develops business and platform requirements end-to-end.
Partners with business stakeholders to translate business goals into actionable client experience improvements with technology.
Determines release goals for a narrow platform product or a component of a large product.
Identifies best practices for continuous product development improvement.
Identifies innovations and leads “test and learn” experiments to create platform products that increase client value.
Clearly communicates progress and product performance to key stakeholders.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in Digital, Technology, and Financial Services·
Prior Digital Product management experience within financial services, a leading tech company, or an early/growth stage funded start.
Prior leadership experience across Wealth businesses, especially digital wealth management and/or client experience.
Mastery of agile product development in partnership across business stakeholders, technology groups, and go-to-market teams.
Entrepreneurial mindset, digital savviness, and strategic thinking to deliver a truly innovative client-first wealth management solutions from 0 to 1.
Able think big, challenge norms, and expand our thinking to deliver a Wealth platform that brings great client value as well as drives business goals.
Ability to create a multi-year vision, roadmap, and plan to execute in support of our goals with a go-to-market approach layered in (commercialization).
Consumer-centric; empathetic towards the client with the ability to put yourself in their shoes.
Obsession with digital products inside and outside of financial services – where are the trends in the industry and where can Citi leapfrog the competition?
Ability to create OKRs, communicate our ways of measurement, and socialize progress towards our objectives & goals on a regular basis.
Distinct analytical background with the ability to find data, analyze the information, derive insights, and distil the results quickly and turn it into actionable business strategy.
Strong understanding of technical problems and how to break down the work involved in solving them.
A willingness, appetite, and perseverance to do what it takes to take the product from concept to launch.
Sharp; you think on your feet, quickly come up with innovative solutions and are always one step ahead of the industry.
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication.
Great team member and partner – willing to go the extra mile to support peers and elevate the talent of our Digital Product team.

Education:

Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

The Digital Product Management team oversees the end-to-end Digital client experience supporting Investment products for Wealth globally. This role is critical to support key strategic priorities on a multi-year basis for Wealth.

added.title: Group Lead Product Manager (Patient Data Platform)
added.description:
Our healthcare system is the leading cause of personal bankruptcy in the U.S. Every year, over 50 million Americans suffer adverse financial consequences as a result of seeking care, from lower credit scores to garnished wages. The challenge is only getting worse, as high deductible health plans are the fastest growing plan design in the U.S.
Cedar’s mission is to leverage data science, smart product design and personalization to make healthcare more affordable and accessible. Today, healthcare providers still engage with its consumers in a “one-size-fits-all” approach; and Cedar is excited to leverage consumer best practices to deliver a superior experience.
The Role
Cedar is improving the healthcare financial experience. Our technology improves the overall patient billing and engagement experience, enabling healthcare providers to thrive in a constantly evolving environment while helping patients understand the cost of their care.
Cedar is looking for a Group Lead Product Manager to lead our Patient Data Platform team. Cedar's next generation of products, including agentic workflows, operator tools, and standalone billing experiences, all depend on a unified, reliable, and extensible data foundation. As the product lead, you will co-own that foundation: the normalized data model, transformation pipelines, integration standards, and data exchange patterns that turn raw data feeds into clean, trustworthy patient accounting records that power Cedar's product portfolio.
This is one of the most impactful and technically challenging roles at Cedar. You bring deep expertise in how health systems generate and exchange clinical and financial data: data feeds, real-time integrations, HL7 messages from EHR systems like Epic, athena, and Cerner, and will apply that knowledge to shape how downstream products and AI-powered agents consume that data to drive patient and operator experiences. Your end-to-end perspective across people, process, and technology will set the course for how Cedar integrates complex and sensitive health system data at scale. You and your team will ensure that Cedar's products and agents have reliable, cross-system access to accurate, up-to-date, and secure information, enabling the next generation of intelligent healthcare financial workflows.
Cedar is committed to a flexible work environment, so this role, like many of our other roles, is remote-friendly.
Responsibilities
End-to-end ownership:

Own the Patient Data Platform from strategy through execution. Help identify gaps in Cedar's data capabilities, define solutions, and drive delivery alongside engineering and integrations. Engage directly with clients and EHR partners to understand upstream data workflows and translate them into platform requirements.
Internal + external influence:

Work internally across Cedar's product engineering, integrations, payments, and communications teams and externally with Cedar's clients and EHR partners to drive integration standards that support multi-product, multi-provider scale.
Product definition:

Define and evolve Cedar's normalized data across providers in terms of how clinical and financial entities are represented, linked, and made available to product consumers and agentic workflows. Drive data governance standards including data quality tracking, lineage, and contract definitions that give downstream teams confidence in the data they consume.
Roadmapping & Prioritization:

Own the multi-quarter roadmap for the Patient Data Platform, sequencing foundational investments (integration patterns, cross-system identity, data infrastructure) against provider onboarding timelines and product launch dependencies. Make the tradeoff calls between long-term platform bets and near-term delivery commitments.
Partnership with technical leadership:

Co-own data and architecture decisions with Cedar's senior technical leaders, including data architects, engineering leads, and delivery-side integration experts. Translate product requirements into technical constraints and vice versa, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical feasibility.
Data governance and quality:

Establish data quality frameworks that ensure reliable, accurate data SLAs for go-lives.
Metrics and impact measurement:

Define and track platform health and adoption metrics, including SLAs for data accuracy and freshness, integration onboarding velocity, and incident reduction tied to data quality improvements. Use data to inform prioritization and demonstrate platform ROI.

Skills & Experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of experience in product management, co-founder, or related technical role
At least 3 years of experience building and shipping technical products that manage data pipelines, data models, or integration platforms
Experience working with senior stakeholders at large enterprises
Track record of shipping products that deliver measurable results — ideally platform products that unblock multiple downstream product teams
Strong knowledge of data exchanges and integration patterns for major EHR players (e.g., Epic, athena, Cerner)

Bonus Qualifications
Technical background (CS degree, former engineer, or deep comfort reading system design docs and data model ERDs)
Healthcare RCM knowledge - understanding of guarantors, patient responsibility, insurance adjudication, EOBs, and the billing lifecycle
Experience establishing data governance frameworks and driving alignment across engineering, operations, and client stakeholders
Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka, gRPC) and how data flows through ETL/ELT pipelines
Experience leading platform migrations — moving product functionality from legacy systems to modern service-oriented architectures while maintaining production reliability
Familiarity with HIPAA data isolation requirements in multi-tenant healthcare platforms

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
Compensation Range and Benefits
Salary Range: $204,000-$240,000
This role is also equity eligible
This role offers a competitive benefits and wellness package

*Subject to location, experience, and education

What do we offer to the ideal candidate?

A chance to improve the U.S. healthcare system at a high-growth company! Our leading healthcare financial platform is scaling rapidly, helping millions of patients per year
Unless stated otherwise, most roles have flexibility to work from home or in the office, depending on what works best for you
For exempt employees: Unlimited PTO for vacation, sick and mental health days–we encourage everyone to take at least 20 days of vacation per year to ensure dedicated time to spend with loved ones, explore, rest and recharge
16 weeks paid parental leave with health benefits for all parents, plus flexible re-entry schedules for returning to work
Diversity initiatives that encourage Cedarians to bring their whole selves to work, including three employee resource groups: be@cedar (for BIPOC-identifying Cedarians and their allies), Pridecones (for LGBTQIA+ Cedarians and their allies) and Cedar Women+ (for female-identifying Cedarians) 
Competitive pay, equity (for qualifying roles), and health benefits, including fertility & adoption assistance, that start on the first of the month following your start date (or on your start date if your start date coincides with the first of the month)
Cedar matches 100% of your 401(k) contributions, up to 3% of your annual compensation
Access to hands-on mentorship, employee and management coaching, and a team discretionary budget for learning and development resources to help you grow both professionally and personally

About us 

Cedar was co-founded by Florian Otto and Arel Lidow in 2016 after a negative medical billing experience inspired them to help improve our healthcare system. With a commitment to solving billing and patient experience issues, Cedar has become a leading healthcare technology company fueled by remarkable growth. "Over the past several years, we've raised more than $350 million in funding & have the active support of Thrive and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z).
As of November 2024, Cedar is engaging with 26 million patients annually and is on target to process $3.5 billion in patient payments annually. Cedar partners with more than 55 leading healthcare providers and payers including Highmark Inc., Allegheny Health Network, Novant Health, Allina Health and Providence.

added.title: Sr Director, Product Growth
added.description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal is seeking a Senior Director, Product Growth to lead end-to-end growth across our U.S. consumer credit portfolio, including PayPal Credit, PayPal Cashback Mastercard, and Venmo Credit Card. This leader will shape and drive a cohesive strategy spanning customer acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and lifetime value. Working across the PayPal and Venmo ecosystems, the role will bring together product, marketing, pricing, rewards, channel, and lifecycle strategies to unlock new growth opportunities, deepen customer relationships, improve the end-to-end experience, and drive portfolio health and sustainable growth.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

Drive revenue growth and global market expansion by identifying and cultivating strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities
Lead the negotiation with external partners and engage cross-functional support colleagues to ensure the successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships
Develop and execute an overall business strategy to identify and cultivate strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities to drive revenue growth and global market expansion
Influence the negotiation with external partners, engaging cross-functional support colleagues, to ensure successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships
Align product and business levers (such as pricing and FX) to maximize revenue and market expansion opportunities
Engage closely with product, engineering, and architecture teams to drive the architectural runway and determine the best technical implementation/design
Represent the end customer on an ongoing basis and use this knowledge to drive effective prioritization and decision-making

Minimum Qualifications:

12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Role Scope & Priorities

Shape the vision for growth across the U.S. consumer credit portfolio - PayPal Credit, PayPal Cashback Mastercard, and Venmo Credit Card - leveraging industry best practices, the broader PayPal and Venmo ecosystems, and innovative growth drivers.
Develop and execute an overall business strategy that unifies new-customer acquisition and existing-customer growth across the three products into a cohesive portfolio strategy.
Support acquisition strategy across the portfolio and partner with the US Consumer and Venmo teams to unlock cross-sell and upgrade opportunities, optimize placement and targeting, and expand the addressable customer base.
Partner with Product, Risk, and the issuing bank to improve the application, underwriting, onboarding, and activation experience and improve funnel conversion.
Partner to drive existing-customer growth across early-month-on-book, engagement, reactivation, retention, and win-back, while improving the end-to-end customer experience.
Shape and align growth levers including product roadmap inputs, go-to-market and marketing strategy, pricing and rewards economics, offers and incentives, channel mix, and customer lifecycle management.
Champion the voice of the customer and influence priorities across US Consumer, Venmo, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Risk, Analytics, Finance, Legal and Compliance, as well as issuing bank, network, and merchant partners.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, with success measured through portfolio health and product growth, delivered jointly with the US Consumer team and partner functions.

Experience & Capabilities

Issuer-side credit card experience required, with demonstrated experience currently leading or having previously led a sizable credit card portfolio at a major issuer.
Demonstrated track record driving both new-customer acquisition and existing-customer growth for a consumer credit or card portfolio.
Demonstrated ability to manage and influence key portfolio and P&L performance levers, including revenue, costs, credit and fraud losses, pricing, rewards, and lifecycle economics, while operating with an owner mindset.
Strong understanding of consumer credit needs, consumer behavior, and portfolio P&L dynamics.
Experience developing strategy and roadmaps for large-scale products and translating business priorities into measurable execution.
Experience working with issuing bank and network partners in a partnership or co-brand credit model.
Experience leading significant co-brand or portfolio negotiations or renegotiations.
Breadth across risk, fraud, product, and operations
Experience with card processors such as Fiserv and navigating both legacy platforms and modern digital experiences.
Proven ability to lead through complex, highly matrixed organizations and influence cross-functional teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify gaps and initiate solutions in complex environments.
Strong communication skills, with experience presenting portfolio performance, insights, and recommendations to senior internal and external leaders.
Exceptional people leadership capabilities, with experience building, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

SoFi is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead one of our most strategic product areas. As a senior individual contributor and product leader, you'll set vision, define strategy, and drive execution on complex, high-impact initiatives that shape how our members borrow, save, spend, invest, and protect their money.

This role is inherently cross-functional. You will work closely with engineering, design, data science, marketing, operations, finance, risk, legal, compliance, and executive leadership to set strategy, prioritize features, secure resources, and execute. You'll bridge technical and business worlds to drive profitable business growth while managing risk, and you'll influence broader company strategy well beyond the boundaries of your immediate team.

As a product leader in our organization, you'll be expected to inspire with your vision and roadmap, set ambitious goals, be gritty, and be accountable to results. The specific team and product area will be scoped during the hiring process based on business needs and your background.

What You’ll Do

Own and evolve the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for your product area.
Break vision into phases, prioritize, and drive backlogs for launch with your dedicated engineering teams.
Drive platform and product strategy focused on scalability, reliability, security, and regulatory compliance.
Partner deeply with engineering to make critical architectural decisions and guide long-term investments.
Engage with risk, compliance, legal, and security teams to align product capabilities with regulatory requirements.
Define success metrics and rigorously measure performance, member impact, and business outcomes.
Lead complex build-vs-buy evaluations, including vendor assessments and technology trade-offs.
Lead experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact on key outcomes like member outcomes, engagement, and revenue.
Influence broader company strategy, mentor other product managers, and raise the bar for product craft across the organization.
Communicate the vision, strategy, execution plan, and customer impact to all stakeholders, including the highest levels of leadership in the company.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in a technical, finance, or quantitative field.
8+ years of product management experience.
Proven track record leading technically complex or highly strategic products at scale.
Deep technical fluency and ability to collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and architects on trade-offs and design decisions.
Demonstrated ability to balance long-term platform and product investments with near-term delivery needs.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, particularly with engineering, design, data science, security, compliance, legal, and analytics.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity for diverse stakeholders and present to C-level leadership.
Experience owning end-to-end product delivery and P&L or key business outcomes.
Comfort navigating ambiguity, trade-offs, and evolving constraints in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have

MBA or advanced degree in a technical, business, or quantitative field.
Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience with data-driven, personalized, or AI-powered consumer products.
Experience building and mentoring high-performing product teams.
Passion for helping members achieve financial independence and get their money right.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Senior Manager Product Manager will be accountable for the overall lifecycle, from development to production to long-term performance, of the Fixed Wing product lines within the Power Transmission Systems business at Collins Aerospace Advanced Structures business. Interfaces with customers for program requirements to ensure successful completion

KPMG is currently seeking an Associate Director, AI Enablement Product Owner to join our Digital Nexus technology team.

Responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end product roadmap and release schedule for Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI platforms, partnering with vendor account teams and internal technical/platform owners to plan, prioritize, and communicate upcoming model, feature, and capability releases across the organization
Continuously evaluate new AI capabilities and platform updates from Anthropic and OpenAI against other AI platforms and vendors, assessing business fit, risk, and competitive positioning to inform adoption and platform strategy recommendations
Act as the primary liaison between Anthropic, OpenAI, and other AI vendors, technical/platform owners, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on roadmap, priorities, and messaging; partner with business stakeholders across functions to identify, define, and prioritize high-value AI use cases
Design, launch, and manage preview and early access programs for new AI capabilities, coordinating pilot participants and technical/business stakeholders, gathering and synthesizing feedback, and translating results into go/no-go and broader rollout recommendations

Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Experience evaluating and defining use cases for generative AI/LLM capabilities across platforms preferred, along with working knowledge of AI product lifecycle management, technical release management, and change/enablement methodologies

added.title: Director - Product Management, Agent Platform
added.description:
About WSO2

WSO2 provides the foundational technology that powers the agentic enterprise, enabling organizations to build, govern, and scale autonomous, AI-driven systems. Its unified stack includes an agent platform, an industry-recognized API platform, integration platform, an analyst-recognized identity platform, and an engineering platform to deliver trusted, scalable digital experiences. WSO2’s open-source, API-first, and AI-enabled approach helps enterprises to accelerate innovation. Founded in 2005, WSO2 has offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Spain, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, generating over USD 100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit wso2.com to learn more.
About the Role

WSO2 is building the next generation of its agentic AI platform, extending our open-source integration, API management, and identity heritage into the era of autonomous AI agents. We're looking for a Product Manager to own the WSO2 Agent Platform, not just the roadmap, but the pricing, packaging, adoption metrics, and commercial outcomes of the platform.
This is a build-and-own role for someone who has shipped enterprise platform products before, understands how open-source and commercial tiers coexist, and can translate deep technical fluency in the agentic AI landscape (agent orchestration, tool-use protocols, governance, identity-for-agents) into a product strategy.
What You'll Own

Product strategy and roadmap
for WSO2's agentic AI platform capabilities, spanning agent management, tool/connector governance, agent identity and access control, and observability, in collaboration with product managers across the company.
Competitive positioning
against both hyperscaler agentic platforms and infrastructure-native competitors.
Pricing and packaging
- including usage-based and consumption models appropriate for agent workloads (token/call volume, agent-hours, tool invocations).
Outcome metrics for the Agent Platform - including adoption, usage, and contribution to revenue.
Go-to-market partnership
with sales, marketing, and field engineering to translate platform capability into enterprise deals.

What We’re Looking For

8-12+ years in product management
, with at least 3+ years owning an enterprise platform product, in the AI space, end to end (not just roadmap ownership).
Problem-first discovery:
continuous, hypothesis-driven discovery with enterprise customers, design partners, and field teams. You turn recurring pain points in running agents in production (governance, trust, cost, reliability) into validated problem statements and success criteria before any feature is committed to the roadmap.
Domain fluency in the agentic AI landscape
: agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent systems, tool-calling/MCP-style protocols, agent identity and authorization (OAuth/OIDC extensions for non-human identities), and AI governance/observability.
AI platform, middleware, integration, API management, or identity platform background
- ideally from a company solving similar problems
Open-source commercialization experience
- you understand how community adoption funnels into enterprise revenue, and how to make packaging decisions that don't cannibalize the open-source flywheel.
Enterprise buyer fluency
- comfortable in rooms with CTOs, platform architects, and procurement, translating technical capability into business value and defensible pricing.
Evidence of shipping 0-to-1 or 1-to-n platform products
in ambiguous, fast-moving markets - the agentic AI category is still being defined, and you'll need to make calls without full market consensus.

Nice to Have

Prior startup or scale-up experience where you launched a product rather than inheriting one.
Prior P&L or revenue ownership experience
Public speaking, analyst relations, or thought-leadership experience positioning a company in an emerging category.
Familiarity with WSO2's existing product suite or comparable platforms.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Copay Programs
added.description:
Description

From intake to outcomes, CareMetx is dedicated to delivering industry-leading patient access solutions and support services that help patients quickly start and stay on specialty therapy treatments. We provide scalable, efficient digital hub services for pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers, streamlining workflows with seamless integration for patient enrollment, consent, and prior authorization. Our best-in-class patient support services enhance every step of care, connecting patients, providers, and brands to drive better outcomes and accelerate time-to-therapy.

Job Title:
Senior Product Manager, Copay Programs

POSITION SUMMARY:

CareMetx is seeking a Senior Product Manager for Copay Programs to define, shape, and continuously improve how CareMetx delivers pharmaceutical copay program services to pharma manufacturer clients. This is a senior product role with a unique dual mandate: deep subject matter expertise in pharmaceutical copay programs combined with the product thinking needed to build scalable, high-quality service capabilities.

The Senior PM for Copay Programs does not own client relationships — that accountability rests with Account Management. Instead, this role defines what CareMetx's copay program capabilities look like, how they are delivered, and how they evolve over time. You will work closely with Account Management, Operations, and vendor partners to understand needs, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement across CareMetx's copay program portfolio. This role is central to CareMetx's strategy of positioning as a value-added partner in the pharmaceutical reimbursement space.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Copay Program Product Ownership
Own the definition and ongoing evolution of CareMetx's copay program service model — including how programs are configured, delivered, monitored, and improved.
Serve as CareMetx's senior internal authority on pharmaceutical copay program mechanics — including program design, eligibility rules, adjudication logic, benefit structures, and reimbursement operations.
Identify gaps in CareMetx's current copay program capabilities and develop clear, prioritized plans to close them.
Translate client needs surfaced by Account Management into well-defined program requirements, operational standards, and vendor specifications.
Lead periodic reviews of active programs to identify optimization opportunities across benefit design, eligibility configuration, adjudication logic, and vendor performance.
Stay current on industry trends, competitive landscape, and vendor platform capabilities to inform CareMetx's copay program roadmap.
Vendor Management & Performance
Serve as CareMetx's primary operational point of contact for reimbursement vendor partners — managing day-to-day performance against established program standards and SLAs.
Define program requirements and configuration standards in partnership with vendors, ensuring delivery aligns with client commitments.
Monitor vendor delivery across active copay programs, identifying service gaps, data quality issues, and operational risks, and driving timely resolution.
Facilitate regular vendor performance reviews and maintain clear documentation of issues, commitments, and improvement plans.
Provide informed input into vendor contract renewals and SLA definitions based on operational experience, partnering with leadership on formal negotiations.
Cross-Functional Enablement
Act as the primary copay SME for Account Management — providing program guidance, answering complex client questions, and preparing AM teams for client conversations, business reviews, and new business discussions.
Partner with Operations to ensure copay programs are executed accurately and efficiently, providing subject matter guidance on program setup, configuration, and issue resolution.
Build and maintain CareMetx's internal copay program knowledge infrastructure — including training materials, process documentation, escalation frameworks, and quick-reference guides.
Develop and deliver copay program training for Account Management, Operations, and Client Services teams.
Participate in pre-sales conversations and new client onboarding as the copay SME, partnering with AM to represent CareMetx's capabilities.
Roadmap & Strategic Direction
Define and maintain CareMetx's copay program capability roadmap — prioritizing improvements, new program types, and vendor enhancements based on client needs, operational feedback, and market trends.
Translate market trends and client feedback into actionable capability recommendations for CareMetx leadership.
Partner with Product and Operations leadership to shape CareMetx's longer-term copay platform strategy, including Build/Buy evaluation.
Define success metrics for CareMetx's copay program capabilities and report performance to senior leadership on a regular cadence.
Reporting & Analytics
Establish and govern the standard for copay program reporting — ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and actionable insight delivery to support AM in client-facing conversations.
Define reporting frameworks that are scalable across vendors and programs as CareMetx's copay portfolio grows.
Oversee the translation of adjudication data, utilization trends, and program metrics into clear performance narratives.
Identify anomalies or trends in program data and proactively communicate findings to AM and Operations teams.

Qualifications

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

7+ years of experience in pharmaceutical patient services, hub services, specialty pharmacy, reimbursement program management, or related product/operations roles.
Deep working knowledge of pharmaceutical copay program mechanics — eligibility, adjudication, benefit design, and reimbursement operations.
Demonstrated product management experience — defining requirements, owning service or capability roadmaps, and driving cross-functional execution.
Proven ability to serve as an internal subject matter expert, advising and enabling account management and operations teams.
Experience managing vendor or partner relationships at a senior level — including performance oversight, SLA accountability, and issue resolution.
Strong analytical fluency; able to interpret program performance data and translate findings into clear recommendations.
Excellent communication skills; comfortable translating complex program concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

Prior experience defining or scaling a copay, reimbursement, or patient services capability within a growing organization.

Background in both product management and pharmaceutical operations — candidates who have crossed from one discipline to the other are strongly encouraged to apply.

added.description:
About Evolve

Evolve is a biosensing-driven adaptive training platform built for enterprise and high-performance use cases. We combine physiological signals, EEG, PPG, eye tracking, and behavioral data, with structured training programs to drive measurable performance, regulation, and cognitive outcomes in real-world deployment.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive execution across Evolve's program and platform roadmap as we move toward commercial launch.

This role serves as the connective tissue across engineering, research, hardware, design, and leadership teams, ensuring that multiple work-streams move forward in alignment and come together into a cohesive product. Success requires the ability to translate product direction into clear requirements, priorities, and execution plans while balancing customer needs, technical constraints, scientific rigor, and delivery timelines.

The Senior Product Manager owns product requirements, scope definition, prioritization, dependency management, and day-to-day cross-functional coordination. Working closely with the CSO, engineering, and research teams, this person ensures the product evolves as one integrated system and that teams have the clarity needed to execute effectively.

This is a highly hands-on role - writing detailed PRD’s and training scopes and is comfortable moving between technical discussions, implementation details, and delivery planning. Pragmatic, decisive, and execution-oriented, they help turn strategy into shipped product.
Key Responsibilities

1. Drive Product Integration Across Programs and Platform
Coordinate execution across Evolve's programs and platform initiatives, ensuring they evolve as one integrated product
Partner closely with hardware, software, firmware, research, and design teams to align requirements and priorities
Define and manage integration requirements across hardware capabilities, biosignal systems, platform infrastructure, and user experiences
Identify dependencies, risks, and critical decisions early and drive resolution
Maintain alignment between product roadmap, technical implementation, and customer outcomes

2. Own Product Requirements and Scope
Author PRDs, scope documents, user stories, acceptance criteria, and engineering specifications
Translate product strategy into clear, actionable requirements that teams can execute against
Work closely with research and engineering teams to accurately capture system behavior, feedback logic, and platform requirements
Ensure requirements account for hardware constraints, software architecture, signal quality, and deployment realities
Drive scope review and scope close processes to ensure clarity, ownership, and delivery confidence

3. Drive Cross-Functional Execution
Coordinate delivery across engineering, hardware, research, QA, and design teams
Work hand-in-hand with software engineering teams throughout definition, implementation, testing, and release cycles
Partner with engineering leadership on prioritization, sequencing, and delivery planning
Make day-to-day product tradeoff decisions within approved roadmap direction
Ensure teams have the clarity and alignment needed to execute effectively

4. Manage Planning and Readiness
Maintain visibility across active initiatives, milestones, and delivery timelines
Manage cross-functional dependencies and surface risks proactively
Support release planning, pilot readiness, and major phase transitions
Escalate strategic tradeoffs with context and recommendations
Help ensure releases are stable, validated, and ready for deployment

Experience & Background

Required
6–10 years of product management experience delivering complex, integrated hardware-software products
Experience working closely with software engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from requirements through release
Experience collaborating with hardware, firmware, and technical teams where product requirements span physical devices and software platforms
Proven experience authoring PRDs, requirements, scope documents, and engineering specifications
Strong cross-functional experience working with engineering, research, hardware, and design teams
Strong technical aptitude and ability to understand system architecture, integrations, data flows, and implementation tradeoffs
Experience operating in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities and ambiguity

Preferred
Experience with biosensing, wearables, physiological signal-based products, or real-time data systems
Experience with adaptive systems, AI-enabled products, or closed-loop feedback platforms
Experience supporting enterprise pilots, research studies, or field deployments
Experience with VR/AR, immersive technologies, or human performance products
Familiarity with regulated or evidence-based product environments

Skills & Traits
Strong systems thinker who can create clarity across hardware, software, data, and user experience
Pragmatic, decisive, and comfortable making tradeoff decisions
Clear communicator who can work effectively across technical and non-technical teams
Outcome-driven and execution-oriented
Builds trust through competence, accountability, and follow-through

Why Join Evolve

This is an opportunity to help build a category-defining platform at the intersection of neurotechnology, biosensing, AI, and human performance. You will work directly with leadership, engineering, and research teams to bring cutting-edge technology from research and pilot deployments into real-world enterprise applications and commercial scale.

updated.title: Sr. Product Manager, AI
updated.description:
About Kiddom

Kiddom is transforming K–12 education by bringing high-quality curriculum, instructional tools, and student analytics together in one coherent system. We are building Learning Intelligence Technology (LIT),
a new category that gives educators the infrastructure to plan, teach, assess, and respond to student needs. With Kiddom, educators spend less time managing administrative burden and more time delivering meaningful student instruction. Kiddom helps schools and districts deliver more equitable, effective, and adaptive learning experiences.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager
to set the vision for AI at Kiddom, shaping how personalization, insights, and automation transform teaching and learning. You'll partner with AI researchers, engineers, and designers to bring intelligent features like recommendations, tutoring assistants, and predictive insights to market, translating research into scalable, teacher- and student-facing products. This role suits a PM with strong AI/ML fluency who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast through experimentation, and can bridge technical and non-technical teams while embedding trust, fairness, and responsibility into every feature.

You will...

Set the vision for AI at Kiddom – Define how artificial intelligence transforms teaching and learning experiences, leveraging personalization, insights, and automation to deliver measurable impact.
Shape AI-first experiences – Partner with AI researchers, engineers, and designers to bring intelligent features to market, from recommendations and tutoring assistants to predictive insights for educators.
Translate research into products – Identify high-potential AI capabilities and evolve them into scalable, teacher- and student-facing solutions that drive adoption and outcomes.
Drive experimentation and iteration – Run pilots, test new models, and iterate quickly to discover what resonates in real-world classrooms.
Ensure trust, safety, and equity – Lead with responsibility, embedding fairness, transparency, and guardrails into all AI-powered features.
Bridge technical and non-technical teams – Translate complex AI/ML concepts into user-centered strategies, aligning researchers, engineers, GTM, and curriculum teams.
Champion outcomes, not features – Ensure AI delivers clear value: saving teachers time, helping students progress, and improving institutional decision-making.

What We’re Looking For...

5+ years of product management experience, with significant work building or integrating AI/ML-powered products.
Proven success leading SaaS products at scale, ideally with AI capabilities embedded in workflows or user-facing features.
Startup and growth experience – you thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities shift and ownership is essential.
Strong understanding of AI/ML systems, APIs, model lifecycle, and responsible AI practices.
Ability to balance innovation and speed with ethical and educational responsibility.
Exceptional influence and communication skills—you can simplify AI concepts, inspire teams, and drive alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.
Background in education/ed-tech, NLP, or adaptive learning is a plus but not required.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Education, or a related field required; MBA or Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred

What we offer

Full time permanent employees are eligible for the following benefits from their first day of employment:
Competitive salary
Meaningful equity
Health insurance benefits: medical (various PPO/HMO/HSA plans), dental, vision, disability and life insurance
401k plan
One Medical membership (in participating locations)
Flexible vacation time policy (subject to internal approval). Average use 4 weeks off per year.
10 paid sick days per year (pro rated depending on start date)
Paid holidays
Paid bereavement leave
Paid family leave after birth/adoption. Minimum of 16 paid weeks for birthing parents, 10 weeks for caretaker parents. Meant to supplement benefits offered by State.
Commuter and FSA plans
